status.nobrowser.description: An agent session is running, but no browser is connected to it. Open the browser with the extension and check the pairing token.

pairing.title: Pairing token
pairing.description: Paste this token into Beifahrer's settings in each browser, once. It lets the extension talk to the agent sessions on this computer.

pairing.other.description: {path} holds a different token. A browser paired with that one cannot connect: paste the token above instead. An older Beifahrer that is still running may use the other one until it is restarted.
